transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. 

Um, well, I came in because I've been having this problem lately when I try to talk to people. Like, at work, if a customer asks me a really simple question—like when their ring repair will be ready—my answer just goes all over the place. I'll start talking about the repair invoices, and then somehow I'm talking about garden soil, and then my mortgage papers... and I can just see them looking at me, completely lost. It's just getting really hard to communicate normally.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or extremely energetic lately?
No, not at all. I haven't felt euphoric or... unusually energetic lately. I definitely haven't had any kind of extreme energy like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Yes, actually. Sometimes when the shop is really quiet, I'll hear a woman muttering my name. It sounds like it's coming from the polishing room. And... I also smell things sometimes, like burning metal, even when I know all the torches are completely turned off. It all feels real enough that I always get up and go check to make sure everything is okay back there.
During the times when these experiences were happening, have you also had a period where you felt unusually depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, I have. Um, during the worst months, that heavy sadness and just a complete loss of interest in things were happening right at the same time. I'd be dealing with all that while I was hearing my name in the shop, and also feeling completely sure that the customers were coming in just to check up on our payments. So, yes, it was all happening together.
Have you ever heard the voice or had those suspicious beliefs during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes, actually. There was a stretch before the depression really settled in where I was still feeling okay... I was still running my jewelry-making classes and keeping up with my gardening. But even during that time, for several weeks, I kept hearing those noises coming from the polishing room. And I was still really worried that the customers were coming in just to watch the business and check up on us. So, yes, the voices and those worries were there even when I wasn't feeling depressed.
During a time when you were not feeling depressed, did the suspicious belief that customers were checking up on your payments continue?

Yes, it did. Like I mentioned a moment ago, before the depression really hit me hard, there was a period of several weeks where I was feeling fine. I was keeping up with my jewelry classes and doing my gardening, but I was still hearing those noises from the polishing room. And yes, during that same time, I was still really worried that the customers were only coming in to watch us and check on our business. So those beliefs were definitely there even without the depression.
Have you found yourself showing much less emotion in your face or voice than you used to?

No, I don't think so. Um, I haven't noticed anything like that, anyway. I mean, even when the sadness was really heavy, I think my voice and my expressions were still pretty much the same as they've always been. Nobody has pointed out that I seem flat or anything like that to me.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or extremely energetic?
No, I've never had anything like that. I've never felt unusually high or had extreme energy. It's mostly just been the depression and the other things I mentioned.
Was there ever a time when the voices or suspicious beliefs lasted for at least two weeks while you were not depressed at all?

Yes, like I was saying before, there was a stretch before the depression really settled in. I was still running my jewelry classes and doing my gardening, feeling fine, but for several weeks I kept hearing those noises from the polishing room. And I was still worrying that the customers were watching the business. So, yes, it definitely lasted for at least two weeks while I wasn't depressed at all.
